title: Document the build phase
description: Give operators a thorough walkthrough of the build phase in HOWTO.md (both verbs, the build-manifest the agent fills in, the status vocabulary, every failure mode, and where build sits in the loop), update README.md (Build section + loop description), and polish the CLI help text. No code/behavior changes.
acceptance_criteria: HOWTO.md has a dedicated build-phase section as thorough as the scaffold section.
README.md describes build init and build and no longer lists build as a placeholder.
appbuilder help text documents both build verbs.
